opening.argument: The presentation solicits Litecoin earnings through both supposedly free returns and paid participation. Its title promises “0.06ltc daily without investment” and instant wallet receipt, while the speaker asserts that “this platform is paying” and that users are cashing out. Viewers are also told they can deposit money to purchase a mining plan, turning payment into the basis for promised mining income. The visible affiliate section lists a 15% total level bonus across four levels, and the speaker directs viewers to copy and share a personal referral link. These features establish an earning solicitation built on paid plans and recruitment, not merely neutral information.
